title: Ephemeral environment crediting and metering specification
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Define product and billing behavior for ephemeral (sandbox/test) environments: how developer credits are allocated, how usage is metered and surfaced, auto-reclaim / expiry behavior, and invoice-level visibility for customers and internal finance. Goal is to make sandbox usage predictable for customers and reduce manual reconciliations for Finance.
background: Customers frequently create ephemeral test environments (feature branches, sandbox tenants) backed by API keys or short-lived tokens. These environments currently consume production credits which can lead to surprise invoices and high support noise. Finance and Support request a formalized entitlement + metering model that: (1) lets teams allocate timeboxed credits to ephemeral environments, (2) ensures transparent invoice line-items, (3) supports auto-reclaim and reclaim audit logs.
goals: Introduce a first-class ephemeral environment entitlement that can be attached to orgs/projects
Default allocation policy for self-serve accounts and a configurable policy for enterprise customers
Surface per-ephemeral-environment usage on invoices and in Console with breakdown by model/route
Auto-reclaim unused ephemeral environments and provide audit trail plus email notifications
non_goals: Chargeback across sub-organizations (out of scope for MVP)
Complex per-token dynamic pricing (defer to later iteration)
Full UI redesign of the Console billing page (only add new panels)
user_stories: As a developer, I can spin up an ephemeral environment with an explicit credit allocation so I am not worried about surprise charges
As an account owner, I can allocate a pool of ephemeral credits to a project and see per-environment consumption
As Finance, I can see invoice line items mapping to ephemeral credit consumption and export a CSV for reconciliation
As Support, I can view the reclaim audit log and reason about why an environment was reclaimed
requirements: R1: Entitlement model - add 'ephemeral_credits' entitlement to plan schema; integer credit units
R2: Allocation API - POST /orgs/:id/ephemeral-allocations to allocate N credits to a project/environment with start/end timestamps
R3: Default policy - free-tier: 500 ephemeral credits/month per org; paid tiers: configurable via Console by admins
R4: Metering - attribute all token/usage events to ephemeral environment id; store usage in hourly buckets
R5: Invoicing - produce invoice line items: 'Ephemeral environment usage - <env name>' with quantity=credits consumed and unit price = plan rate
R6: Auto-reclaim - environments marked ephemeral are automatically shutdown after expiry + 48h grace; credits unused are returned to pool and flagged in audit
R7: Notifications - send email to env owner 72h and 24h before reclaim and immediately after reclaim
R8: Console UX - new 'Ephemeral usage' tab under Billing showing allocations, live consumption, reclaim history
R9: Audit trail - immutable log entries for allocation, consumption spikes (>20%/hour), manual reclaim, and auto-reclaim
R10: Admin overrides - org admins can manually top-up or extend ephemeral allocations; all overrides recorded
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given an org on paid plan, when admin creates an ephemeral allocation for project X for 7 days with 1000 credits, then allocation is visible in Console and via GET /orgs/:id/ephemeral-allocations
AC2: Given an ephemeral environment making calls, usage is attributed and reflected within 15 minutes in the 'Ephemeral usage' panel and in the hourly metering dataset
AC3: Given expiry + 48h grace, the environment is shut down automatically and Console shows 'Auto-reclaimed' with timestamp; credits are returned to the org's ephemeral pool
AC4: Given invoice generation run, ephemeral usage appears as separate line items with correct cost calculation (credits * unit_price) and matches metering report CSV export
AC5: Given a reclaim event, the audit log contains actor (system or user), reason, timestamp, and credits returned; logs are immutable and accessible to Support
AC6: Notifications are sent at 72h and 24h prior to reclaim and immediately upon reclaim; sample emails exist in Design spec
AC7: Admin manual override to add credits increases allocation and is reflected in billing/metering within 10 minutes
analytics_metrics: Metric: ephemeral_credits_consumed (sum credits by day, env, org)
Metric: reclaim_rate (percent allocations auto-reclaimed vs manually reclaimed)
Metric: invoice_discrepancies (count of invoices with reconciliation errors)
SLA: metering pipeline latency p95 <= 20 minutes for reflected usage
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (MVP): API + backend metering + basic Console panel + invoice line items for self-serve & paid orgs (beta opt-in)
Phase 2: Enterprise controls (configurable default, per-project policies), audit retention 365 days, CSV exports for Finance
Phase 3: Cross-org chargebacks, cost-allocation across teams, per-model unit pricing adjustments
engineering_tasks: ENG-ephemeral-001: Add ephemeral_credits entitlement to pricing service and UI flags
ENG-ephemeral-002: Implement allocations API and DB schema (allocations, consumption_hourly, reclaim_log)
ENG-ephemeral-003: Metering: tag incoming requests with ephemeral_env_id and update aggregation jobs
ENG-ephemeral-004: Invoicing: include mapping layer to translate credits->currency line items and add to invoice generator
ENG-ephemeral-005: Orchestration: implement graceful shutdown + reclaim workflow and notification hooks
ENG-ephemeral-006: Console: panels for allocations, live usage graph, reclaim history and manual override controls
ENG-ephemeral-007: RBAC checks for admin/manual overrides and audit stream integration
qa_tests: QA1: Create allocation via API, run traffic, verify usage appears in Console and matches metering dataset
QA2: Force expiry path, verify 72h/24h emails are queued and final reclaim occurs after grace period
QA3: Generate invoice for month with ephemeral usage and verify line items, CSV export matches metering report
QA4: Admin override flow: add credits, then consume; verify billing reflects change and audit log entry exists
QA5: Load test metering pipeline with 10k ephemeral envs to validate aggregation latency and storage scaling
risks_mitigation: Risk: Metering lag causes mismatch between Console and invoice -> Mitigation: max staleness window on invoices; collect p95 metrics and delay invoice generation if threshold exceeded
Risk: Users abuse free ephemeral credits -> Mitigation: rate-limit ephemeral env creation per org and add fraud detection signals
Risk: Accounting reconciliation failures -> Mitigation: include reconciliation report and checksum per invoice run, Finance sign-off during beta
Risk: Security: ephemeral env leaks credentials -> Mitigation: require token scoping and optional short-lived API keys for ephemeral envs
implementation_notes: Backend services must be able to reconcile credits at invoice-time. Prefer append-only tables for reclaim_log and consumption_hourly to ease audits. Coordinate with Finance to add a reconciliation job that runs daily during beta.
deployment_notes: Feature gate: ephemeral-billing beta flag on org record. Roll out to 5% of paid orgs first, monitor invoice discrepancies and support tickets for 2 billing cycles before full rollout.
